The shaft is modeled as a homogeneous, isotropic, linear-elastic solid circular bar under small-deformation Saint-Venant torsion.
No transverse shear force, bending, or axial load is considered; all shear response is torsional shear caused by the two applied torques.
Stress concentrations at the fixed support and at the torque application sections are neglected.
The x-axis is positive from the fixed support at x = 0 to the free end at x = L = 1200 mm.
Positive torque follows the right-hand rule about the +x axis.
T1 = +200,000 N·mm is applied at x = 1200 mm.
T2 = -200,000 N·mm is applied at x = 400 mm.
Static equilibrium about the shaft axis gives the fixed-support reaction torque T0 = 0 because T1 + T2 = 0.
The polar moment of inertia is J = π d^4 / 32 = π (30 mm)^4 / 32 = 79,521.56 mm^4.
The outer radius is c = 15 mm.
The torsional rigidity is G J = (76,923.1 MPa)(79,521.56 mm^4) = 6.11704 × 10^9 N·mm^2.
The internal torque is T(x) = 0 for 0 ≤ x < 400 mm.
The internal torque is T(x) = +200,000 N·mm for 400 mm < x ≤ 1200 mm.
At x = 400 mm the internal torque jumps by -200,000 N·mm due to the concentrated applied torque T2.
The torsional shear stress is τ(ρ) = T(x) ρ / J, where ρ is the radial distance from the shaft center.
The maximum shear stress occurs at the outer surface, ρ = 15 mm, in the segment 400 mm < x ≤ 1200 mm.
The maximum shear stress is τ_max = T c / J = (200,000 N·mm)(15 mm) / 79,521.56 mm^4 = 37.73 MPa.
The maximum shear stress is zero in the segment 0 ≤ x < 400 mm because the internal torque there is zero.
The angle of twist is governed by dφ/dx = T(x) / (G J) with φ(0) = 0.
The angle of twist is φ(x) = 0 for 0 ≤ x ≤ 400 mm because the internal torque is zero in that interval.
The angle of twist for 400 mm ≤ x ≤ 1200 mm is φ(x) = (200,000 N·mm)(x - 400 mm) / (6.11704 × 10^9 N·mm^2).
The angle of twist at the free end is φ(L) = (200,000 N·mm)(800 mm) / (6.11704 × 10^9 N·mm^2) = 0.02616 rad.
The free-end twist in degrees is 0.02616 rad × 180 / π = 1.50 degrees, in the positive T1 sense.
The maximum torsional shear strain at the outer surface is γ_max = τ_max / G = 37.73 MPa / 76,923.1 MPa = 4.90 × 10^-4.
